sentences.text: Bathytheristes, meaning 'Reaper of the deep,' is an extinct genus of chimaera that lived during the late Early Jurassic epoch.
This animal is known from only one species, Bathytheristes gracilis, whose specific name refers to the slender nature of its tooth plate.
It belongs to the class Chondrichthyes, a group that includes cartilaginous fish like sharks, and is related to the modern elephantfish.
The fossil of Bathytheristes was discovered in the Posidonia Shale Formation at Ohmden, Germany.
Taxonomically, Bathytheristes belongs to the parent group Callorhinchidae.
Bathytheristes lived between 184.2 and 182.9 million years ago during the Toarcian age.
